card.name: "May" after other signs and symptoms
card.fires_on: The word "may" right after a phrase like "Other clinical manifestations" or "Other signs and symptoms also", just before a list of additional effects.

modes.label: May before extra symptoms list
modes.description: "may" follows a sentence listing main symptoms and introduces further possible manifestations.
modes.example: Other clinical manifestations<< may>> include hepatitis, nephritis, hematological

card.plain: It marks the point where a label says other symptoms may also occur and is about to list them.
evidence: DRESS typically, although not exclusively, presents with fever, rash, lymphadenopathy, and/or facial swelling. Other clinical manifestations<< may>> include hepatitis, nephritis, hematological
